mapper.update: MERGE INTO T_TM_DAY_FINISH_TOTAL a USING (SELECT * FROM T_MES_TM_DAY_FINISH_TOTAL WHERE DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}) b ON (a.SCHEDULE_DATE = b.SCHEDULE_DATE AND a.TREAD_CODE = b.TREAD_CODE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.FINISH_QTY = NVL(b.FINISH_QTY, 0), a.UPDATE_TIME = now() WHERE a.DEL_FLAG = '0' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (a.ID, a.SCHEDULE_DATE, a.TREAD_CODE, a.FINISH_QTY, a.CREATE_TIME, a.DEL_FLAG) VALUES (SEQ_CX_FINISH_QTY.NEXTVAL, b.SCHEDULE_DATE, b.TREAD_CODE, b.FINISH_QTY, b.CREATE_DATE, b.IS_DELETE)
